name: content-freshness-audit
description: Once a month, finds pages and articles that have not been touched in months or that mention past dates, old prices or links to things that are gone, and proposes the edits for you to review.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: On the 1st of every month at 9:00

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Content not updated in 6 months, past dates and seasons, prices that no longer match, links to missing records

howItWorks.label: Suggests
howItWorks.text: A concrete edit for each problem, written in the content's own style

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve each edit before it is saved

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short to-do list to Slack, if you pick a channel

plugins.reason: Posts the monthly list of stale content to a channel

data.description: The main text of the page or article
When the content was last changed; every record has _updatedAt, a hand-kept "reviewed on" date is better when the schema has one
Whether the content is published, so drafts and archived pages are left out
The page's slug or URL, used in the report and to find links between pages
Product prices, to catch prices quoted in content that have since changed
Product slugs or names, to catch links and mentions of products that no longer exist or are unpublished

parameters.label: When to run
parameters.description: On the 1st of every month at 9:00 by default

parameters.label: Stale after (months)
parameters.description: Content not updated for this many months is reviewed

parameters.label: Most items per run
parameters.description: The rest wait for next month, oldest first

parameters.label: Propose edits
parameters.description: When off, the audit only lists problems and changes nothing

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Optional; without it the list stays in the run notification
